### Kevin Michaels

###### Managing Director

Kevin Michaels is Founder and Managing Director of AeroDynamic Advisory, a boutique aerospace consultancy. He has 40 years of professional experience, including more than 600 consulting engagements for leading aviation and aerospace companies across the globe.  
  
Kevin co-founded AeroStrategy and successfully grew the consultancy until its acquisition by ICF International in 2011. Earlier, he was Director-Strategic Development at Rockwell Collins Government Systems and a Principal with The Canaan Group, a consultancy that co-founded the MRO Conference series.
